versions.name: Tough Glove
versions.text: At the start of every 3rd turn, add a Draft to your hand. If you have 4 or less cards in hand, add 2 instead. If you have 7 cards in your hand, add it to your deck.

versions.name: Tough Glove
versions.text: At the start of every 2nd turn, add a Draft to your hand. If your hand is full, add it to your deck instead.
